doc.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Family income and his parents' work
summary: The family was middle class; his father bought a house and worked for Standard Oil, his mother did domestic work.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Would you describe your neighborhood and your family’s income as middle class? It seems like you had some money to be able to afford . . .

Middle class. When I was about two years old, my father bought a house there. I don’t know whether that was middle class, or what it was. They were immigrants. I think maybe at that time he was working for the Standard Oil company.
I really wouldn’t know. I don’t know.
